Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Senior Backend Engineer position in your grid data team.
Your posting describes services that receive meter and substation readings,
check them and serve them to forecasting models. That is the kind of work I have
done for the last five years: Python APIs and asynchronous workers that other
people depend on every day.

At Example Cloud I built the APIs and workers of our developer platform. When
our endpoints became slow, I added request tracing first and only then revised
the slowest paths, which reduced p95 latency by 20\%. I also moved long-running
jobs to a queue of workers with retries and idempotent steps, an approach I would
bring to an ingestion path where readings arrive late or twice.

Your team shares on-call duty for what it builds. I designed a deployment
workflow with health checks and automatic rollback that cut our manual steps from
nine to three, and I documented the services until four colleagues could run
them on call.

I have not worked with energy data yet, and I would enjoy learning it from your
team. Thank you for your consideration; I would be glad to talk.

Kind regards,\\
Alex Example
